questions.question: What does break do inside a loop?
options: It jumps to the next iteration
explanations: Correct. break terminates the loop and execution continues at the next line after the loop.
There is no pause statement in Java.

questions.question: What does continue do inside a while loop?
options: It skips the rest of the body and moves to the next iteration
explanations: It does not terminate the program.
Correct. continue skips the rest of the body of that iteration and re-evaluates the condition.
It does not reset the counter.
When i == 2, break exits the loop. The printed values are 0 and 1.
If i == 2 break exits before printing 2, so it does not print 2.
014 makes no sense — break exits in the middle of the loop.
